reason: I've never seen anyone on TikTok unbox a Baghdad Express parcel and none of my friends have used it, so I'm not trying it yet. Most of what I resell I can get in Shorja today, and 21,000 in fees on one kilo eats the margin I'd make reselling it.
objection: No reviews or unboxing videos I can check, and I'd wait 2 to 3 weeks without knowing if the stuff is any good for my shop. Abu Ali's name helps, but I don't know him.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a TikTok unboxing or another shop owner I know showing a batch they got through the trader account at the 4% fee, with the real landed cost per piece.
